text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH 5xx error-rate spike for service=redwood-inference-gateway-prod (us-west1). Alert PD-48291. Current 5xx rate: 18% (baseline 0.3%). Paging rotation: @lee (primary).

lee (oncall): acked. diving in — grabbing logs and metrics. any recent deploys?

sam (sre): no deploys in the last 2h from our CI. seeing increased backend latency to model-host pool.

tia (eng): can you paste the error pattern? 502/504/500?

lee (oncall): mostly 502 + 503. sample tail:
```
2026-03-14T15:05:03Z ERROR handler.go:248 upstream return status=502 content-length=0 route=/v1/generate
```

pagerbot: Escalation rule: primary acked at 1827504330; if not resolved by 1827504390 will page secondary.

carla (prodops): scaling policy triggered autoscale+burst; but instance creation latency is high. provisioning backlog in us-west1.

sam (sre): hypothesis: upstream model workers hitting OOM or kernel-level preemption. checking GPU node metrics.

lee (oncall): noticed multiple 502s correlate with node restarts (kube events). logs: `OOMKilled` on pod inference-worker-7.

tia (eng): ok immediate mitigation options: 1) route traffic to eu-west fallback pool, 2) reduce batch size via runtime config, 3) temporarily disable heavy clients via rate-limiting. which do we want first?

emily (support): customers contacting support — several enterprise customers reporting timeouts in us-west. need ETA for public/status update.

sam (sre): doing quick canary route to eu-west. running `curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/v1/route/shift -d '{"from":"us-west1","to":"eu-west1","pct":25}'`

lee (oncall): +1 to route shift. initiating now.

incident-bot: Runbook triggered: `inference-gateway-5xx` (runbook v3). Steps: scale down batch_size -> apply kernel patch -> migrate traffic.

carla (prodops): applied temporary quota for heavy API keys (rate limit 20r/s). confirming with support which customers hit it.

tia (eng): reduced default batch_size from 32->8 for us-west gateway via config rollout id cfg-2026-0314-07. rollout in 2m.

sam (sre): EU route shift at 25% applied. monitoring error rate.

lee (oncall): error-rate dropped to 8% after batch decrease and routing 25%. still above baseline but trending down.

emily (support): sent heads-up to affected customers and posted internal status note. drafting public status: "Partial degradation in us-west affecting some requests; mitigation in progress."

pagerbot: PagerDuty PD-48291 acknowledged by lee at 1827504330. Escalation canceled.

sam (sre): additional action: cordon + drain nodes with OOM history, repro capture for worker image. creating ticket INF-1298.

lee (oncall): handing off to sam for deeper investigation. my shift ends in 40m; will follow on call channel.

sam (sre): taking ownership. ETA for root-cause triage 1.5h. will coordinate postmortem and rollback plan if recurrence.

carla (prodops): recommend keep routing 25% until next checkpoint. planning to add 2 spare nodes in us-west.

emily (support): external status updated at 15:20 UTC. message queued for 15:30 with ETA note 1h.

tia (eng): grabbing heap and gpu logs from the killed pods. saving to S3: s3://redwood-inference/incidents/1827504321/artifacts.tar.gz

lee (oncall): thanks team. final note before handoff: mitigation successful so far, customers impacted but no data-loss, continue tracking.

sam (sre): will post follow-up thread with RCA draft and timeline. closing on-call handoff. :hand:

incident-bot: Incident PD-48291 transitioned to "mitigated" at 1827504678. Please file postmortem in /incidents/postmortems within 72h.

carla (prodops): adding after-action items to INF-1298: improve autoscaler headroom, alert sensitivity tuning, and throttling for heavy clients.

emily (support): logging customer outreach tickets and recommended compensation draft for impacted enterprise accounts.

sam (sre): noted. will include customer impact table in the postmortem.

-----
(attachments: logs, pod events, metric graphs uploaded to incident thread)
